students.why: The official Software profile states Hao Pan joined Tsinghua in2024 and points its teaching/advising paragraph to haopan.github.io. That owned homepage states Sep2024 joining and recruitment for PhD/master candidates, then research projects and publications. The two source bodies do not identify a named current student or dated Tsinghua advisee roster. The profile’s statement that he collaborated with talented students and the publication bylines do not establish which people hold a Tsinghua student/adviser relationship. No claim of zero students is made. The owned homepage does publish nine dated Student Collaborators, explicitly under his past Microsoft Research Asia work (2016–2024). Those names remain MSRA-scoped leads, with no source evidence placing those episodes in his Tsinghua lab.

students.why: The official Software profile and owned homepage identify Zhenpeng Chen and his AISE research/recruitment. The separately linked complete publication page has no student/adviser section or degree-role context. The three bodies do not publish a named current or dated former Tsinghua student roster; recruitment and coauthors are not converted into student membership. This is a source-limited absence-of-roster finding, not evidence that the lab has no students.
